messages:
mira: Quick note: Next/Edge sample fails on Vercel after switching mono-repo to pnpm (isolated). Node builds ok but edge build errors: 'Package "@redwood/sdk" has no export named "./runtime/edge"'.

joel: classic pnpm symlink problem. esbuild resolves the physical file under .pnpm and skips package export subpath resolution.

sam: reproduced locally: apps/web imports '@redwood/sdk/runtime/edge' -> `pnpm install` (isolated) -> `pnpm --filter apps/web run build` -> esbuild throws missing export. Switching to node-linker=hoisted fixes it.

tia: two pragmatic fixes: 1) add a root proxy file (runtime-edge.js) that re-exports dist/runtime/edge and expose it as './runtime-edge' in exports so apps import '@redwood/sdk/runtime-edge'; 2) document pnpm node-linker=hoisted as a CI workaround. Also TS needs types for the subpath or a declaration file.

mira: I'll add the proxy to examples, add a README note, and open an SDK patch to add types exports for the runtime subpath.

ci-bot: Preview CI: built example in default and hoisted pnpm modes; proxy import passes in both. :white_check_mark:

joel: long-term: add CI matrix for pnpm/yarn/turborepo permutations and a small SDK test that simulates workspace install (symlink) to catch regressions.

mira: filing follow-ups for docs, CI, and the types mapping. thanks!
